title: [finding] 130 anchored better-auth 1.7.1 measurements are unverified against the installed 1.7.2 — pay down per surface, never as a batch
body:
Filed out of the review of #13979 (card #13940), by the `domain:devx` execution PM seat. #13940 closes on that PR; this card carries the residue it deliberately did **not** pay, so that the debt exists as a record rather than as an unwritten intention.

## What the residue is

#13979 shut the **class**. Its gate holds one shape — a sentence fusing a permanent fact with a **live reading of a moving value** (*"the installed better-auth 1.7.1"*, which after a pin bump is not stale but **false**) — and that population is held at **0**.

It left **130 sites** alone on purpose. Those are **anchored historical statements**, shaped like:

> `[#11374] Bound from better-auth 1.7.1's own MySQL schema`

Every one of them is **true as written**: it names the version the measurement was taken against. What is unknown is whether the same measurement **still holds on the installed version**. The family now pins at `^1.7.2` across all eleven members (`pnpm-workspace.yaml`, moved in #13938).

⇒ The debt is not falseness. It is that **nobody has re-run those 130 measurements**, and no mechanism will ever tell you which of them changed.

## Why this is not paid as a batch — measured, not assumed

The review of #13979 measured the batch remedies and both fail:

1. **A pin-equality gate cannot be built honestly.** Checking stamps against the installed version would have **fabricated 130 measurements** — restamping `1.7.1` → `1.7.2` on sentences whose truth is precisely that they say 1.7.1. It would also have **corrupted another gate's test input**: `scripts/check-prerelease-pin-watch.mjs` carries `'better-auth': { versions: ['1.7.0', '1.7.1'], … }` inside a `--fixture` call feeding its own self-test.
2. **A hand sweep is what this card's parent ruled against.** Four have already run, and the population they chase grew **29 → 95** across them. A fifth would restamp without measuring, which is the failure mode, not the fix.

⛔ **Do not open a PR whose purpose is to walk the 130.** Such a PR is refused on sight.

## The remedy shape that is in scope

Per surface, opportunistically:

- When a file carrying one of these stamps is next touched **for another reason**, re-run **that file's** measurement against the then-installed version and re-anchor the sentence to the version actually verified.
- If re-running is not affordable inside that PR, **leave it**. An anchored stamp is honest as-is; a guessed one is not. Leaving it is the correct outcome, not a skipped chore.

That is the whole remedy. This card is a **debt register, not a ratchet** — it ships no gate and fails no build, because any gate over this population would have to guess.

## Reproducing the population

Once #13979 is on `main`:

```
pnpm check:vendor-version-stamps
```

The gate reports the historical bucket rather than enforcing it; the count in that report is this card's population.

## Provenance

The ruling this card implements, from the #13979 ACCEPT (Q1):

> Card closes on this PR; the residue is filed as its own card, to be paid down **per surface as each is next touched**, never as a batch.

Left unassigned and ungraded — the triage seat grades.
